answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 6229 Country: Pakistan Title: Is working in money market allowed by Islam? Question: Is working in money market allowed by Islam? Answer ID: 6229 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 774/722=L/1429) By ?money market? if you mean currency exchange, then it is lawful observing all conditions, there is no wrong in it.
